max_renormalized_deviation.description: Largest difference between the quasienergies and the static junction with $\Gamma J_0(A/4)^2$ over the scan

crossing_amplitude.description: Drive amplitude at which $D$ becomes the lowest dressed state

critical_gamma.description: Static critical coupling $\Gamma_c$ of the singlet–doublet transition

vv0_error.description: Van Vleck error of order 0 at $A=6$, largest of $S$, $S^*$, $D$

vv2_error.description: Van Vleck error of order 2 at $A=6$

vv2_error_decoupled.description: Van Vleck error of order 2 at $J_0(A/4)=0$

vv_first_order.description: Order 1 minus order 0 for a cosine phase drive, where $H_{-k}=H_k$

vv0_renormalized.description: Order 0 minus the static junction with $\Gamma J_0(A/4)^2$

scaling_error0.description: One lead, phase and level drive: order-0 error at $\Omega=40$

scaling_error1.description: One lead, phase and level drive: order-1 error at $\Omega=40$

scaling_error2.description: One lead, phase and level drive: order-2 error at $\Omega=40$

scaling_slope0.description: Fitted exponent of the order-0 error versus $\Omega$ (asymptotically $-1$)

scaling_slope1.description: Fitted exponent of the order-1 error versus $\Omega$ (asymptotically $-2$)

scaling_slope2.description: Fitted exponent of the order-2 error versus $\Omega$ (asymptotically $-3$)
